patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Navigate into the "Seek Girl ⅤⅢ_Data" folder Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the contents of the downloaded patch archive into the "Seek Girl ⅤⅢ_Data" folder mentioned above, merging folders and overwriting files if prompted It's working if: On the mission menu there are pictures of girls for the level previews (not just blue boxes), and when you finish the first mission there is a lewd mini-game, not just a clothed picture of the girl. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
